answer_1.quote: To simulate real-world privacy risks, we attach two types of captions to each image: functional captions and high-risk captions.

answer_3.quote: To analyse modality reliance in multimodal inference, we use Gemini as an external judge to determine which input type each model mainly uses under the visual with functional caption setting.

answer_4.quote: To further assess the naturalness and plausibility of the generated captions, we conduct a human evaluation. Three native Korean speakers who are not involved in the caption generation process are invited to participate in the evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Participants judge whether each caption was written by a human or generated by a model.
